Subject: Q3 QBR prep — consolidated runway workbook + compact account asks

Team — attaching a compressed workbook of the current sales runway (tabbed by ARR band and close month). I pared down each account page to a one-paragraph snapshot (prospects/risks/next step) so the exec readout stays tight.

What I need from you by EOD tomorrow: two bullets per named account where you own the relationship: 1) a single-line current ask (what we need to close), 2) a one-sentence risk with suggested mitigation. Keep it customer-facing (no internal-only shorthand).

Notes:
- Workbook: 2027-11-02_qbr_runway_workbook.xlsx (attached) — the forecast column marked "S1" is our consolidated committed view; S2 is best-case.
- Please flag any PO/contract hold-ups. If Acme or Starlight need a PO/contract redline, call it out.

I'll stitch responses into the executive two-pager and a per-account one-pager (account_snapshots_compact.docx). Planning a dry run Tue 11/9.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov

Redwood Inference

Olga — sending my compact blurbs inline for the accounts I'm covering. I kept to the format you asked.

ACME IOT — ask: Commit to integration PO (Net 30) for pilot cluster (estimated $120k ARR) by 11/15. Risk: Procurement requires SOC-2 attestation and a vendor security addendum; mitigation: provide our SOC-2 package + propose a 30-day pilot SOW that limits exposure.

STARDUST (prospect) — ask: Finalize pricing decision on LLM inference tiers (dedicated vs hosted) by 11/20. Risk: Landmark IT team biased to vendor-hosted solutions; mitigation: offer a 6-week hybrid pilot + dedicated performance numbers from our benchmark sheet.

Notes: ACME has indicated legal review, see my comment in the workbook cell (S1 -> "legal_hold"). I attached a short extract with the two highest-priority accounts.

Alex / Jia — looping you in on a short summary we're preparing for our Q3 executive review. We've included the ask below (short) and attached the compact snapshots for your reference.

Acme IoT (pilot integration) — Redwood ask: approve the pilot PO (Net 30) covering initial cluster and onboarding services ($120k ARR equivalent for the 12-month forecast window). Risk: procurement may request additional security docs; mitigation: we will provide SOC-2 package and a scoped 30-day pilot SOW limiting production access.

If you can confirm the PO timeline (target sign by 11/15) and whether procurement will need additional paperwork, that will help us finalize the QBR numbers. Attaching: Acme_PO_signed_stub.pdf (signed stub for internal reference).

—Olga

Olga — thanks for the clear note and the compact snapshot. Procurement is OK to move on the PO but needs the SOC-2 bundle and a short SOW (we prefer 30 days). I can confirm our internal target: sign by 11/15 if we get the SOC-2 package by 11/08. I attached the signed PO stub for you (Acme_PO_signed_stub_final.pdf).

We also asked our infra team for a short latency requirement doc — they want a 99th percentile under 150ms for the pilot. If you can confirm Redwood's performance profile on the pilot cluster (KV cache + quantization profile we discussed), we'll close this in time.

Alex Rivera
Head of Edge Platforms
